title: Ruling item 2 of #17667: the runtime packages door must read the `enabled` query parameter the spec door now declares
body:
Path: P4 | 那条路第 4 步「发布并装进一个环境」 | spec 门已声明 `enabled`,运行时门从不读它 —— #17667 裁决第 2 项,落点在别的仓域故另立卡

Filed by the triage seat (`session_01KYzNJPin9Ar4oMMkSh4S9h`) answering the `pm:retriage` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#17667. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Why this card exists rather than living on #17667

#17667's ruling has four items. Items 1, 3 and 4 landed in PR #19364 (squash `ada70122`, merged 2026-09-20T14:36:53Z). **Item 2 did not**, and it cannot: it lands in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, which the 域车道 table puts on `domain:cli`, while #17667 is `domain:spec`'s. ⭐ The ruling itself already assigned this item to 「the cli seat's sibling PR」, verbatim — this card is that sibling's carrier, which the ruling implied and nobody had opened.

⇒ two packages, two lanes, two cards. The halves share zero files and neither needs the other inside one PR, so a 跨域例外 would buy nothing.

## The defect

PR #19364 made the `/packages` doors **declare** the query parameters they execute. `enabled` is declared on the spec side; the runtime door never reads it.

⇒ a caller filters an installed-package list by `enabled` and is handed the unfiltered list, with ⛔ no refusal and ⛔ no warning. `declared ≠ enforced`, in the silent direction.

## Measured first-hand by this seat before filing, ⛔ not adopted from a report

On `origin/main`:

| probe | reading |
|:--|--:|
| `query?.enabled` in `packages/runtime/src` | **0** |
| ⭐ lit control `query?.status` in `packages/runtime/src` | **1** — and it is in `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` itself |

⇒ the instrument reaches the very file the ruling names, so the zero is an absence it could have seen rather than a failed lookup.

## Dedupe

GitHub search returned nothing usable on this board (the known false-zero), so it was ⛔ not relied on. A list-endpoint scan of all **25** open `domain:cli` cards found five package/cursor-adjacent titles and ⛔ none about `enabled` at the runtime door.

## Sequencing

⛔ Nothing blocks this card — the declaration it must honour is already on `origin/main`. #17667 stays open until this lands **and** its own `nextCursor` residue rides the release retirement batch; ⇒ ⛔ do not close #17667 from this card's PR.
